_comment: BDD mode: the Cucumber scenarios only. coverageAnalysis=perTest is required so that Stryker reports NO_COVERAGE for mutants the scenarios never execute -- that status is what separates MS_all from MS_cov, and what makes the differential-kill comparison set S computable. Versions pinned: Stryker 10.1.1, cucumber-runner 10.1.1, @cucumber/cucumber 12.2.0.
